title: Deterministic HP recovery for RecoverMagic
objective: Implement the first Step 6 healing/support mechanics slice using source-native RecoverMagic, FirstPartySingle/FirstPartyAll and HP Absolute/RecoverToMax semantics.
hypothesis: A recovery resolver can reuse verified target selection and cost/atomicity patterns to spend MP once, restore living ally HP deterministically, support self-heal via a first-party anchor, emit explicit Healing facts including zero effective healing at full HP, and avoid revival or unsupported modifier semantics.
claim_boundary: No Percentage healing formula, revival behavior, SP cost, attribute modifier, combat-state effect, Unity presentation/playback, or undocumented original PAL3 formula is introduced. RecoverMagic, target ranges and impact-type names come directly from pinned upstream enums.
design_constraints: Append Healing to CombatEventKind without renumbering existing event kinds.
Add clamped RestoreHp to CombatantState without changing ApplyDamage semantics.
Support only RecoverMagic with exactly one HP effect and zero SP cost.
Support positive Absolute HP recovery and RecoverToMax.
Reject Percentage and other impact types until semantics are separately locked.
Allow caster state as the selected target for self-heal.
Do not revive defeated targets; dead targets are rejected/filtered by target selection.
Spend MP once per cast after all expected preconditions and identity checks.
Expose one SkillCast fact plus one target-addressed Healing fact per resolved target.
Allow Healing=0 for a legal cast on an already-full target.
Expose result/event collections through read-only wrappers.

attempts.description: Initial HP recovery primitives/resolver/test stack replayed successfully, but fast-lane C# compilation failed before any tests executed.
attempts.failure: Fast Lane run 32358054901 failed with CS1513 at RecoverySkillResolver.cs(276,24): a closing brace was expected. The patch file contained the full 286-line source, but its new-file hunk header incorrectly declared +1,276, so the replayed workspace contained only the first 276 lines.
attempts.fix: Correct 0023 new-file hunk header from +1,276 to +1,286. No recovery semantics or tests changed.

attempts.description: Rerun the same HP recovery semantics/tests after correcting only the 0023 new-file hunk length.

reusable_lessons: A new-file unified-diff hunk can replay without a controller failure yet still truncate source if the declared added-line count is too small; compile evidence catches this class of patch-generation defect.
Self-heal does not require a new target-range enum: a FirstPartySingle anchor may legitimately point to the caster state.
Recovery can preserve the existing atomic cast boundary by validating target identity and resource sufficiency before MP/HP mutation.
Zero effective healing at full HP is still a useful resolved fact and does not require special-case presentation authority.
next_recommended_experiment: Continue Step 6B with attack/defense/speed/luck support modifiers, keeping lifecycle/state-engine concerns separated for Step 7.
